errors.klass_naming.heading: Rename these groups before using the tournament
errors.klass_naming.no_klass: {tournament_name}: group {group_name} (ID {group_id}) has no recognised klass. Add “Klass” and the correct capital letter A–H, for example “Klass A”.
errors.klass_naming.keyword_spelling: {tournament_name}: group {group_name} (ID {group_id}) has an unsupported keyword spelling. Replace the keyword with “Klass”, “klass”, “Grupp” or “grupp”; keep the correct capital letter.
errors.klass_naming.several_klasses: {tournament_name}: group {group_name} (ID {group_id}) declares several klasses. Keep only one klass phrase. If A and B are merged, write “Klass A/B”.
errors.klass_naming.unreadable_klass: {tournament_name}: group {group_name} (ID {group_id}) has an unreadable klass letter. Write “Klass” or “Grupp”, a space, then one capital letter A–H or “A/B”. Separate following text with a space.
errors.klass_naming.unknown_merge: {tournament_name}: group {group_name} (ID {group_id}) has an unsupported merge. Use “Klass A/B” only for a merged A and B group; otherwise use the correct single letter.
klass_naming.retry: Rename the listed groups in the member system and try again. To reload generation defaults after correcting them, close and reopen the generation dialog.

klass_naming.title: Group naming conventions
klass_naming.fixes: How to correct a refused name
klass_naming.fixes_text: Choose the actual klass before renaming. These replacements illustrate accepted syntax; they do not decide which klass your players belong to.
klass_naming.intro: The standings read each group’s klass from its name in the member system. A name that does not follow one of the formats below stops the generation until the group is renamed.
klass_naming.formats_text: Write exactly one klass phrase: Klass, a space and a capital letter A–H standing on its own. Anything may come before it, and birth years or a description may follow after a space, a bracket or a comma.
klass_naming.merged: A and B merged into one group
klass_naming.merged_text: Write both letters, A first, together or joined by /, -, +, &, a comma or a space. Klass A/B is the clearest. A and B is the only merge.
klass_naming.spellings_text: klass in lowercase, and Grupp or grupp, are accepted in place of Klass. The klass letter is still a capital.
klass_naming.participation_text: An ordinary JGP counts klasses A, B, AB, C and D; E to H are read but left out. A Junior-DM counts A to E. A tournament is a Junior-DM when its own name contains Junior-DM, JuniorDM or JDM, so the group names need not repeat it.
